blocks.text: Verified standalone scheme summary. Key administrative parameters and operational guidelines.

items:  Sustainability in Spice Sector through Progressive, Innovative, and Collaborative Interventions
 Launched in 2024 by the Spices Board of India under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 Enhance India’s spice exports and promote value-added products.
 Improve productivity and post-harvest quality of spices.
 Focus on sustainability and international standards compliance.
 2023-24 to 2025-26, aligned with the 15th Finance Commission cycle.
